own_solution.law: Combined ideal-gas law for fixed amount: P1 V1/T1 = P2 V2/T2
assumptions: sealed so amount of gas fixed

defect_reasons.other: T656C ('was warmed by 38 K at constant volume just before its final pressure was read') can be read as the last stage of the heating that reached 360 K rather than an extra 38 K on top of it; the more natural reading gives 398 K and 199 kPa.

notes: Base: P2 = 100*(6/4)*(360/300) = 180 kPa. With a further 38 K at constant 4 L: T = 398 K, P = 100*1.5*398/300 = 199 kPa. Earlier-experiment warming leaves no state relevant to the stated initial state (D); the second piston is a separate system (D). T6EEF and T24F5 carry no number, so they are not same-number variants of TE55F/TB1B2.
